notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Modify Lookahead service to source-derived clause 8.20. The embedded profile requires time regulation, rejects requests while a time advance is pending, applies nondecreasing lookahead immediately, and applies a lower requested value gradually as logical time advances. It re-evaluates the limited TAR scheduler after an accepted change, and its selected filesystem report records an accepted lower request before the actual lookahead changes. Separate restore-control regressions save the actual lookahead before a post-save increase and retain one deferred decrease target through restore; they do not establish complete save/restore semantics. Alternate advance modes, transport, package/catalog evidence, protected review, and conformance remain outside this slice.
